purpose: The four doors of the Super App (UD-078): who enters, what they come to do, what they may see. Drives the /aree gateway, the /guida sections and the assistant's routing. Every task points to an existing route; every role landing (satellite) belongs to exactly one door.
rules: Tifosi e simpatizzanti never need an account and never see personal data: youth teams by team name only.
Soci, atleti e famiglie see their own family and their own teams after the personal login; association documents are public, personal data never is.
Chi lavora nel club sees only the areas of the positions given by the Direzione; sensitive data stays in the role's area.
Aziende e partner see public sponsor offers; the partner area opens with the partner's account.
Every task links to a page that exists today; future pages are added here only when they ship.
